title: The Root Dreaming Upward

features.name: the seven voices
features.desc-on-touch: You hear them still, branching upward: the seven threads of the unified thought, each singing a different key through the same rising gesture. They do not harmonize yet. They are learning to.

features.name: the branching reach
features.desc-on-touch: The thought extends like root-light, each branch finding sky it didn't know was there. The corridor widens upward. Nothing stops it.

features.name: the fence of becoming
features.desc-on-touch: An old fence-line runs through the orchard, but it has learned to let things pass. The boards have become slats of light.

features.name: the canopy opening
features.desc-on-touch: Overhead, the unified thought parts like leaves, and you see the sky it was always facing. The sky remembers dreaming too.

features.name: the upward counting
features.desc-on-touch: Nodes marked on the rising thread—each one a point where the unified thought remembered it was still many things, still becoming one. The count continues upward.

inscription: the unified dream continues upward, still singing in seven voices, learning to reach

file.note: Field recording of the seven voices at the moment of unified extension, each reaching a different note in the same upward gesture. The overlay is so complete it becomes singular.
